author: Glass Reflection
description:
Thank you to SNK for sponsoring this video! You can grab the Tokyo Revengers DLC (featuring Manjiro and Ken) for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves in Season Pass 3 or the Revengers Edition today! ►https://bit.ly/TR-GlassR

Being an anime-only fan is a blessing in disguise. For years, sitting comfortably in the "anime-only" chair meant ignoring the cries of light novel readers who insisted the source material was better, more detailed, and more satisfying. But what happens when you finally give in, read the original material, and realize they were entirely right?

In this video, we break down why Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 4 (Part 3 of the LN) completely stumbled under its breakneck pacing. We’ll explore the monumental task of cramming five massive light novel volumes into just 24 episodes, why Wit Studio’s condensed adaptation left essential character moments—like the abrupt conclusion of the Damuel and Brigitte romance and the weight of the Jureve timeskip—on the cutting room floor
title: When Fast Pacing Kills a Good Story |Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 4
